audience: ecommerce teams with API-enabled Stamped Loyalty 2.0 shops

useCases.title: Find a loyalty customer
useCases.text: Look up a customer by email or platform ID to review their loyalty record. Only connect customer data you may process with your AI service.

useCases.title: Review catalog records
useCases.text: Find products by title, vendor or tags in the catalog Stamped holds.

useCases.title: Locate a platform order
useCases.text: Look up an order using its Shopify, BigCommerce or custom platform ID.

useCases.title: Audit loyalty activity
useCases.text: Read earned or redeemed rewards and points activity. Coupon codes are masked; no redemption or points changes are available.
